facts.headline: Earn SAFE Token with Beefy
facts.summary: Beefy's SafeBoost program lets users earn SAFE tokens over a six-month incentive run on Gnosis Chain. Beyond the how-to, it's a case study in paying yield in a governance token, and the gap between the farmers a program attracts and the stewards a protocol actually needs.
